name: JFrog Ltd.
summary: JFrog Ltd. provides software supply chain platform in the United States, Israel, India, and internationally. The company offers JFrog Artifactory, a package repository that allows teams and organizations to store, update, and manage software packages; JFrog Curation functions as a guardian outside the software development pipeline, controlling the admission of packages into an organization, from open source or public repositories; JFrog Xray, scans JFrog Artifactory to secure all software packages; JFrog Advanced Security, an optional add-on for select JFrog subscriptions; and JFrog Runtime Security, an optional add-on for select JFrog subscriptions to work with other JFrog Security solution…
